						EXPECTED_STATE = 5
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
					}
				}
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = zg361_we_operation_total
					has_variable = zg361_we_operation_used
				}
				var:zg361_we_operation_used < var:zg361_we_operation_total
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ab_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ab_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_state
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ab_revision

			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ab_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m250_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m250_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m250_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m250_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m250_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m250_receipt_choice
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$

			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$

			TICKET_STATE = 5
			OPERATION_ID = 250
			CHOICE = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_record_meeting_contribution_250 value = 3 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_we_operation_used add = 1 }

			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m250_write_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m250_write_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }

			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m250_provenance_choice value = 3 }
			zg361_we_m250_consume_effect = yes
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 1 }

		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ab_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ab_subject

				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_state

				EXPECTED_STATE = 5
			}
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {

						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m250_receipt_subject

						EXPECTED_STATE = 5
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 1
					}
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m250_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m250_receipt_subject

						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$

						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m250_receipt_subject

						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$

						EXPECTED_STATE = 5
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
					}

					}
					var:zg361_we_operation_used < var:zg361_we_operation_total
				}

			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 2503 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 4 } # typed RED, no receipt or business write
	}
	else_if = {

			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ab_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ab_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial

				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$

zg361_we_m251_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m251_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m251_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m251_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m251_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m251_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 251 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m251_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m251_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m251_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m251_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m251_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_record_meeting_refusal_251
				has_variable = zg361_we_m251_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m251_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m251_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ab_owner
			var:zg361_we_m251_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ab_subject
			var:zg361_we_m251_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m251_write_case = var:zg361_case_ab_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m251_write_state = var:zg361_case_ab_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m251_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_object_meeting_refusal
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_resource_meeting
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_resource_capacity
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_resource_manager_score
						}
					var:zg361_we_m251_object_type_code = 251
					var:zg361_we_m251_consumer_contract = 251
					var:zg361_we_m251_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m251_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m251_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m251_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m251_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m251_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m251_object_case = var:zg361_we_m251_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m251_object_state = var:zg361_we_m251_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m251_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m251_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m251_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m251_debt_type_code = 251
					var:zg361_we_m251_debt_consumer_contract = 251
					var:zg361_we_m251_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m251_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m251_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m251_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m251_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m251_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m251_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m251_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m251_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m251_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m251_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m251_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m251_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m251_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m251_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m251_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m251_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m251_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m251_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m251_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m251_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m251_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m251_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m251_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m251_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m251_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m251_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m251_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m251_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m251_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m251_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m251_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m251_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_record_meeting_refusal_251 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m251_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m251_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m251_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m251_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m251_consumer_record_meeting_refusal_251 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m251_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ab_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}
